summary: A summit lookout above Elk Lake in Marion County, Oregon, built in the 1910s-1920s, replaced by an L-4 cab in 1951 and removed in 1969; foundation piers remained in 2014.

facts.design: Summit lookout: cupola cabin, then a 6-foot enclosed L-4 cab (1951 per the register and Firelookout)
facts.status_note: Removed in 1969 (register and Forest Lookouts) or destroyed (Firelookout). A 2014 hiker report says eight foundation piers remained at the summit.

access.note: Reached on foot from Elk Lake per a 2014 hiker report; a 2014 forum thread places the peak in Bull of the Woods Wilderness. No source says the site is closed or describes access today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout dates the cupola cabin to 1922 and Forest Lookouts logs a November 1922 house; the register dates the cupola replacement to 1925. The story shows the 1922 date and notes the register's 1925.
Firelookout says a camp was developed in 1911 and the register says a camp was built in 1912; the 1952 item says first manned in 1909. All three dates appear in the story.
Register and Firelookout say a 6-foot L-4 tower in 1951; the 1952 item describes a 14-by-14 house. Both are kept in the story.
Register and Firelookout give 5,558 ft; the 1952 item gives 5540 feet. The story gives the register figure and notes the 1952 figure.

notes_for_editor: Brief has only the 2010 registration; build, staffing, replacement and removal events come from Forest Lookouts, Firelookout and the register. Build and replacement dates disagree across sources. The only source on the site's condition is a 2014 hiker forum thread, a user report and not a survey; no source describes the site today. Staffing is recorded only to 1944, the last documented staffing; the earlier 'unstaffed as of 1969' had no source. Access is 'unknown' because no source states whether the site is open. Web search snippets were not used as facts; only fetched pages are cited.
